findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - A worker writes one Question paragraph asking whether it may replace the parser and also asking the coordinator to run `forge fix allow-large` for six files. `owner_choices.py:62-63` treats the whole paragraph as one block and removes it when the allowance command appears anywhere in it. Recording the allowance therefore also removes the unanswered parser decision, so close can proceed without it. The test at `tests/test_answered_worker_question.py:42-43` puts the questions in separately prefixed blocks and misses this case.
Adds work: retain separately unanswered questions; F 2 x H 2 = 4; 2 x C = 4
findings.title: Preserve unrelated questions in the same worker handoff

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - A worker on an existing pull request lists six long file paths and puts `forge fix allow-large` after the list, as the brief suggests. `time_records.py:769-785` truncates the shared question to 300 characters. If the command falls beyond that limit, `owner_choices.py:58-65` cannot match it on the teammate's clone, so recording the allowance publishes no wait end and the original machine still reports the answered question. The shared test uses a short question. Even when a shorter question matches, `task.py:819` and `task.py:893` publish the wait end without pushing the allowance or amendment commit: `close.py:638-645` defaults to `push=False`. The original clone can consequently clear the question while still lacking the approved allowance or revised Done-when.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - A worker asks the coordinator to record an owner's approval with `forge decision accept <slug> --by <name>`, and the coordinator runs that command on the fix branch. The Done-when covers the step the question asks for, but this change invokes `answer_command` only for `forge fix allow-large` and `forge fix amend`. `records.py:259-383` accepts and commits the decision without ending the worker wait, so close and next continue to report the answered question.

why: After the coordinator answers a worker's question (for example with forge work --note, or by recording allow-large), the question stays open, so close stops again with 'The worker is waiting for an answer' and needs one more no-change worker round. It happened twice on 21 Nov 2026.
